name: openclaw-execution-gate
description: Transparent confirmation, frozen-call replay, scoped grants, and automation safety for single-user OpenClaw deployments.

scripts.test: bash scripts/run-tests.sh && bash scripts/test-verify-public-template.sh && bash scripts/test-installer.sh
scripts.build: find src bin scripts -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -exec node --check {} \; && bash -n install.sh && find scripts -type f -name '*.sh' -exec bash -n {} \;
